column1: # One line per rule the shared parser decides, with the tree it must produce,
# written out by hand from the grammar rather than captured from the parser.
# `catalogue_parse.py` is the only module the catalogue's two sides share, so a
# wrong rule THERE moves both answers together and the comparison stays green
# (review round 5). This file is the second check that makes such a change
# visible: `catalogue.py` parses each query below and fails if the tree differs.
# `measure/perturbations.tsv` plants one wrong rule at a time in the parser and
# The expected tree is JSON; key order does not matter, the check compares the
# decoded objects. A tab never appears inside a query or a tree here.

column4: what it pins
an empty filter body is None, not a true literal
a number literal keeps its digits as written; the type decides nothing here
a duration parses to its digits and its UNIT SPELLING; how many nanoseconds that is belongs to each side
`m` is minutes and `ms` is milliseconds: the two spellings must not collapse
the non-ASCII spelling of microseconds is a unit of its own
the smallest unit
a duration may be written with no digit before the point
a two-digit hexadecimal escape
a three-digit octal escape, the second one a newline
a four-digit unicode escape
a backtick string has no escapes at all: the backslash and the n stay two characters
`minInt` is a literal with a value, and the value is the smallest signed 64-bit integer
and the largest
a status keyword parses to its NAME; the code it stands for is each side’s own
the same for a kind keyword
`true` is a boolean literal, not an attribute named true
`nil` is its own literal type, which is how presence is written
multiplication binds tighter than addition
exponentiation groups to the right
a minus sign against digits is part of the number, not an operator
a minus sign against a field is the unary operator
negation of a parenthesised comparison
`>>` is descendant, not child
`!>` is the child relation with the negating modifier
`&~` is the sibling relation with the union modifier
`&&` binds tighter than `||`
a bracketed key keeps the dot inside the key rather than splitting the path
a dotted path after a scope is one key
the colon form of an intrinsic
a metric carries its grouping key and its trailing threshold in one stage
`topk` is a stage of its own, with an integer
compare carries the inner spanset and its positional arguments as written
an aggregate stage carries its target, its comparison and its value
select carries its fields in the order written
a hint is a (key, value) pair of text; what `false` means is each side’s own
